concerns.text: The plan states that the zero‑shot classifier (`facebook/bart-large-mnli`) is *‘calibrated on the gold set’* (see “Entity extraction” step). The same gold‑standard annotations are then used as the ground‑truth for computing precision, recall, and intent‑hallucination rates. This creates a circular validation: the classifier’s decision threshold is tuned on the very data on which its performance is later measured, inflating apparent fidelity and violating independence between predictor (model‑generated intent entities) and validation target (human‑annotated intent entities). A scientifically sound design must reserve a held‑out portion of the gold set (or a separate validation set) for threshold calibration, and evaluate the classifier only on unseen data.
